```plato

    //==
    // # Half-edge navigation over PolygonMesh3D corners
    //
    // A corner (see the corner section above) is a directed edge: corner c runs
    // from its own vertex to the vertex of the next corner in the same face. That
    // makes the packed corner array a complete half-edge structure with no side
    // table — the twin of a corner is simply the corner running the other way,
    // found by search rather than stored
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doubly_connected_edge_list).
    //
    // The searches are linear, so the walks below are quadratic in corner count.
    // That is the right trade for the catalog solids (a truncated icosahedron has
    // 180 corners) and deliberately keeps the mesh free of a built adjacency
    // structure; building and storing half-edge adjacency is separate work.
    //
    // Preconditions throughout: the mesh is a CLOSED manifold — every corner has a
    // twin, and the corners around a vertex form one closed cycle. On an open mesh
    // TwinCorner returns the "none" index and the ring walk does not terminate
    // correctly.

    //==
    // Walking within one face.

    // The face a corner belongs to: the number of face starts at or before it.
    // Precondition: the corner is present.
    CornerFace(self: PolygonMesh3D, corner: CornerIndex): FaceIndex
        => FaceIndex(self.FaceCount
            .MapRange(f => self.Faces.Offsets[f] <= corner.Value ? 1 : 0)
            .Reduce(0, (acc, hit) => acc + hit) - 1);
```
